name: sterling
description: Sterling monorepo — plugin sources. The shipped plugin is described in STERLING-SPEC.md section 2.2.

scripts.prepare: npm run build && npm run build:tui
scripts.build: tsc -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/store/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/mcp-server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/tui/tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-stamp.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/check-agent-registry.mjs && node scripts/check-totality.mjs && node scripts/check-spawn-contracts.mjs && node scripts/check-agent-prompts.mjs && node scripts/check-tool-grants.mjs && node scripts/check-skills.mjs && node scripts/check-bundles-fresh.mjs && node scripts/check-failclosed-boundary.mjs && node scripts/check-record-citations.mjs && node scripts/check-projection-fresh.mjs && node scripts/check-stale-claims.mjs --base main
